attributes.name: levels
attributes.description: Comma-separated heading levels to include (auto-generated mode)

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: CSS selector for the container whose headings are scanned (first match wins; docs layouts use 'main article')

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Summary text and nav aria-label of the generated ToC

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: 'horizontal' renders an inline, horizontally scrollable bar (summary hidden, nesting flattened). Omit for the default vertical tree

childAttributes.name: data-toc-ignore
childAttributes.on: heading (or any ancestor) inside the scope container
childAttributes.description: Exclude the heading, or every heading inside the marked container, from the generated ToC

properties.name: entries
properties.type: Array<{ id?: string, text: string, level: number }>
properties.description: Current ToC entries derived from the page headings

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Rebuild the ToC (auto mode) or re-scan authored links (manual mode) after content changes

events.name: page-toc:navigate
events.description: Fired when a ToC link is activated; id is the target heading's id
